notes.title: Freedom Update
notes.content:
[b]Weedcraft Inc[/b], the most current and in-depth tycoon game about the modern American cannabis industry gets even better with the [b]Freedom Update[/b]! It delivers what the players were asking for - a rich and highly customizable [b]sandbox mode[/b]. It also has an easier Chill Mode, new music and a bunch of smaller additions and fixes, all in one huge gift of a DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33698500/312553fa6cf5d0256412d57313a3d2a94acc0add.png[/img]

The "[b]Freedom Update[/b]" contains the following updates and enhancements:
[list]
[*][b]Sandbox Mode[/b] - set up a custom game, tailored to your preferences. Choose any of the cities to begin your business, including 3 new ones!
[*][b]New Options[/b] - Set difficulty, amount of money and available perks
[*][b]Customize Your Character[/b] - choose from old and new portraits, including three special guest stars: streamers skinnedteen, shenryyr and swiftor
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b]
[*][b]Chill Mode[/b] - an easier, more relaxed way to play, that you can toggle for one of the regular scenarios or for the sandbox mode.
[*][b]Soundtrack Update[/b] - 3 new music tracks
[*][b]New Story Events[/b] - plus many more smaller additions & fixes!
[/list]
[b]Weedcraft Inc[/b] explores the business of producing, breeding and selling weed in America, delving deep into the financial, political and cultural aspects of the country's complex relationship with this troublesome and promising plant.

notes.title: DLC IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33698500/f48dcd095ba9a286368e32327a6716ab12353e39.png[/img]

[h1]Our new DLC is LIVE![/h1]

[i]Join Celia Hernandez in her struggle at the dark side of the market and see how legalization influences it. Will you stick to the "old ways" of your family or find your own path among the new opportunities? [/i]

[b]Let's take you through what's fresh[/b]

[list]

[*] Additional, challenging scenario featuring new story, 3 cities and new crises 
[*] More music, less repetition 
[*] Extended smuggling module - lets you set up continued courses
[*] Less cluttered notifications, new management options 
[*] Early employees are now more efficient 
[*] Improved interfaces for “libraries” - including entirely new “Effects Library”
[*] Interface improvements in other places, including growing, social campaigns, setting up activities
[*] Tweaks in the dialogue interface, including the option to skip a conversation (as requested by players)
[*] New and reworked portraits for minor characters
[/list]
 
[b]And a bunch of small fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Less frequent automatic saves
[*] The exotic problem caused by special characters in the installation directory
[*] Rare blocker, when the game is saved in an unusual moment
[*] Better shader support on Mac 
[/list]

We hope you guys are ready to play and thank you again for all the support that has helped to make Weedcraft Inc such a success!

notes.title: Patch v1.04
notes.content:
We fixed the following bugs this patch:
- Game crashing on launch on certain machines
- Game unpausing during dialogues (which led to issues with panels not closing)
- Players being unable to pass the quest "Earning the trust"
- Game loading incorrectly if particular panels were open

Additionally:
- Tutorial images will replace videos on low settings for low-end machines
- You can now skip the splash screens

notes.title: Patch v1.03
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't launch properly on some machines.
- Fixed a bug where grow room conditions settings weren't saved.
- Fixed a bug where workers stopped working.
- Fixed a bug when game would enter an infinite loading after entering a new city.

If you still experience any of the aforementioned issues, please make sure your update applied correctly (you can check game version in game settings) and if it didn't then verify integrity of game data. If you have newest patch and still experience issues, please make your way to our forums where you can find all the information about reporting bugs in our pinned threads: https://steamcommunity.com/app/622720/discussions/0/2605804632880013463/

notes.title: Day 2 Patch (v1.02)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We have just issued a patch that fixes a couple of crucial issues:

- Fixed debug strings being displayed if game was launched on a system in language not supported by our game (now it will default to English),
- Fixed crashes related to memory management that happened when starting a scenario or after playing for a prolonged period of time (they should no longer occur),
- Graphics profile Good, Simple, Fast and Fastest will now use significantly less memory which should help with running the game on low end machines.

Make sure you download the update (you can check your game version in Settings in the lower right corner, it should now display v1.02) and see if that resolves your issues. 

Also, remember to keep your display drivers up to date - having outdated drivers is known to cause those kinds of issues in all games.

If you still experience crashes afterwards then please refer to this topic on our steam discussions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/622720/discussions/0/2605804632883242277/
